title: Aethelgard Municipal Public Procurement and Vendor Ethics Code 2024

sections.heading: Competitive Bidding Thresholds
sections.content: All supply contracts estimated to exceed 100,000 credits must undergo open public competitive bidding published on the municipal portal for a minimum of 21 calendar days. Sealed tenders opened prior to deadline expiration will be immediately nullified.

sections.heading: Conflict of Interest Disclosures
sections.content: All prospective tenderers must submit an affirmative conflict-of-interest declaration listing any familial relationships within the second degree of consanguinity to sitting council members. Failure to disclose results in a 3-year debarment from municipal contracting.

sections.heading: Prompt Payment to Small Enterprises
sections.content: Approved invoices submitted by registered small and micro vendors must be liquidated within 30 calendar days from formal receipt. Overdue invoices accrue statutory interest calculated at 1.5% per month compounded quarterly.
